capabilities: Colour MarkMind Basic nodes and branch curves by hierarchy level
Recolour underline segments using logical tree traversal
Adapt the 24-colour palette to light and dark mode
Re-apply colours after layout or render changes
disambiguation: Not a full styling system or theme editor; it only assigns level-based colours via a bundled stylesheet.
extras: Not affiliated with or endorsed by MarkMind; does not modify MarkMind source code or paid features. Rich mode unsupported. Developed with ChatGPT assistance. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A tiny, lazy companion plugin for Obsidian that automatically colours MarkMind Basic mind maps by hierarchy level
problem: MarkMind Basic mind maps have no built-in way to colour nodes and branches according to their depth in the tree, making deep levels hard to tell apart.
summary: Companion plugin that automatically colours MarkMind Basic mind map nodes, branches, and underlines by their hierarchy level.
